title: VP Sara's team shows Duterte, Santiago, Corona clips; relevance questioned
summary: The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte on Thursday presented video clips of former President Rodrigo Duterte, the late senator Miriam Defensor-Santiago, and the late Chief Justice Renato…

blocks.text: Published November 19, 2026 1:46pm

The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte on Thursday presented video clips of former President Rodrigo Duterte, the late senator Miriam Defensor-Santiago, and the late Chief Justice Renato Corona, prompting some senator-judges to question the relevance of the materials.

On Day 44 of the impeachment trial, defense counsel Mark Vinluan initially presented a clip of Defensor-Santiago during Corona’s impeachment trial, when she was questioning the withdrawal of articles of impeachment of then-House prosecutors.
What went before: The dropping of impeachment articles against CJ Corona

“What is the relevance of all this, Mr. Presiding Officer?... We’re like watching a movie. Then another thing, pagpahingahin na natin 'yung namayapa. That is a different case, this is a different case. This is a different set of senators. Iba 'yun 'yung sinaunang panahon. I really do not understand why we are watching this,” Senator-judge Erwin Tulfo said.
Senator-judge Panfilo Lacson also said that he did not see the relevance of the clip, as this was the opinion of one of the senator-judges in the 2011 trial.
Senate impeachment presiding officer Francis Escudero agreed with Tulfo, ending the presentation of the clip and telling Vinluan to move on.
Vinluan then asked AML Consulting PH head Rainer Dela Fuente on the effect of withdrawing the charges for the predicate crime when it comes to investigating money laundering activities.
House prosecutor and Akbayan Rep. Chel Diokno objected to the question.

Vinluan also presented a clip of Corona being emotional when he faced the impeachment court and saying that it was being used to persecute him. Diokno again questioned the clip, saying that it was irrelevant.

“I do not see the relevance of the statements made by the Chief Justice Corona about his alleged persecution, except that it is an appeal to emotion that I believe has no place in this impeachment trial. Whatever question asked would be immaterial, it would be irrelevant because we could not even cross-examine the late Chief Justice Corona on his statements. And it would be misleading because there is no such evidence of persecution in this case before the court,” Diokno said.
But Vinluan said that impeachment was not a purely legal proceeding.

“There’s a political aspect to it. And I think, your Honor, we’ve been prudent in laying the foundation for our questions so again, Your Honor, we just ask for a little leeway for the defense. The prosecution has had its time,” he said.
After the video was finished, Vinluan asked Dela Fuente on the effect of weaponizing the AMLC against an individual.

“Under Section 16 of the AMLA, Your Honor, there is a prohibition on the use of AMLC information for political persecution. Aside from political persecution, to hamper commerce and trade,” Dela Fuente said.

Lastly, the defense presented a clip of the Vice President’s father, Rodrigo Duterte, when he was asked about a possible impeachment case against then vice president Leni Robredo. Duterte said that he disagreed with any impeachment cases against Robredo.

Vinluan asked Dela Fuente if it was possible for data from the AMLC to be used for prosecution in an impeachment proceeding. Diokno questioned this again, saying that Dela Fuente was a financial investigator for only two years.
Dela Fuente was allowed to answer, merely saying it was possible for AMLC data to be used in such a way.

Before the impeachment court called for a recess, Senator-judge Risa Hontiveros made a manifestation raising a concern on the clips presented. She said that Corona and Defensor-Santiago have both passed, and Rodrigo Duterte is not in the Philippines.
None of them could be questioned by the senator-judges, Hontiveros said.
“Hindi po fair 'yung ganitong situation. Hindi po fair, either sa tatlong taong pinakita 'yung video nila, hindi rin po fair sa Senate impeachment court na ito,” she said.
(This situation is not fair. It is not fair, either to the three people whose videos were shown, and it is not fair for this Senate impeachment court.) —AOL, GMA News
